reason: Added a Keyboard story tagged 'apg' to stories/cmp/components/SegmentedControl.stories.tsx: three items, with the first one checked. Both specs in tests/a11y/apg/cmp/segmented-control.apg.spec.ts (CMP-43, and CMP-42, which needs at least 3 radios) now drive flagships-controls-segmentedcontrol--keyboard. The spec now reads the start index and focuses that item. It is a Playwright spec, so it needs CI to prove it (qual:certify:l5).

Moved the 'tab bar target size' test, unchanged, from tests/e2e/surf/target-size.spec.ts into tests/e2e/surf/app-shell/a11y.spec.ts. That file is already covered by the existing L5 app-shell lane (tests/e2e/surf/app-shell/**/*.spec.ts, pr and main), which is also the file the PRD names. No change to the lane registry was needed. It is a browser test, so it needs CI to prove it.

Implemented with jest proof (Inspector.test.tsx and app-shell.css.test.ts pass): mode='sheet' opens the bottom Sheet at layout='desktop' and the inline aside is hidden with no column reserved; mode='docked' renders the content-sunken material; mode='auto' swaps to content-sunken when the shell resolves wide; Inspector.Root auto-mounts the sheet; a hand-rendered Inspector.Sheet takes priority, so only one dialog opens. The CSS background override was removed. The browser half (tests/e2e/surf/app-shell/inspector.spec.ts in qual:certify:l5/l12) needs CI.

Implemented. menu.apg.spec.ts now checks exactly one tabindex=0 item, that End then ArrowDown wraps to Apple and ArrowUp wraps to Share, that ArrowUp-open lands exactly on Share, and that hovering Share opens the submenu. A new jest fake-timer test in Menu.test.tsx (passing) shows the submenu stays shut at 90 ms and opens after 100 ms. The APG spec needs a browser, so only the remote L5 lane can prove it.

Implemented. A postcss-parse jest test (passing) pins the item heights (32px, and 44px under pointer:coarse), padding-inline var(--ag-space-3), popup min var(--anchor-width) and max min(320px,...), a highlight fill with no backdrop optics, and disabled items that use a colour token with no opacity. The Menu.css:80 child-opacity rule was removed. tests/e2e/cmp/material/** and sizing.spec.ts are now L5 rows in fragments/lanes/cmp.ts. The e2e specs only run on the remote lane.

Implemented. ContextMenu now also opens on the ContextMenu key (keydown is prevented so the menu cannot open twice). Pointer, long-press and key opens now focus the first item instead of the popup. Focus returns to the element that opened the menu after an outside press, which Base UI had left on body. ContextMenu.Root now passes loop through as loopFocus. Jest tests pass for long-press first-item focus and restore, and for Shift+F10 and ContextMenu-key open plus Escape restore. menubar.apg.spec.ts (loop at both ends, the open menu moving to Edit, Escape focusing exactly Edit) and context-menu.apg.spec.ts (three openers, first-item focus, restore) need the remote browser lane. The scene story's area is now a focusable region marked data-context-area.

Implemented. Toast.css adds a 3px border-inline-start rim and drops the title dot. Swiping uses only transform, driven by --toast-swipe-movement-x/y. Below 640px the viewport is calc(100% - 16px) wide. Toast.Viewport wraps the stack in one SurfaceGroup (.ag-toast-stack). Jest (passing) checks one [data-ag-group] chrome host with the 3 toasts as its direct children (so MAT drops their backdrop), --toast-index 0..2, and no group when the viewport is empty. toast.touch.spec.ts was rewritten with no `if` and a strict toHaveCount(before-1), plus a mid-drag transform check, and tests/e2e/cmp/overlays/** is now an L5 lane row. The swipe and visual checks need the remote browser lane. Base UI owns the dismiss threshold (a fixed 40px), so the PRD's '40% of width or 0.5px/ms' is not separately implemented.

Implemented. The box-shadow-only ring on highlighted disabled items is gone, so the shared outline plus inner ring from controls.css covers them. The menubar trigger ring now uses --ag-focus-outer and --ag-focus-inner, inset, with a forced-colors branch. A jest CSS test asserts there is no --ag-color-focus-* and that every :focus-visible rule has an outline. tests/e2e/cmp/focus.spec.ts is now an L5 playwright row. The browser spec only runs on the remote lane.

Implemented. Toast.Action and Toast.Close render a hit-area (jest test passes). Popover.Close (default render) and the AlertDialog Cancel/Action now carry their own hit-area span, the same pattern Dialog.Close uses. Button's suppressInnerParts is unchanged because changing it would leak hit-area into Tour, DatePicker and other metas. 'hit-area' was added to the Toast, Popover and AlertDialog meta.parts, and test:contract stays green. sizing.spec.ts is now an L5 row. The elementFromPoint proof needs the remote browser lane.

Done and green in jest (Slider.test.tsx covers exact Arrow, Shift+Arrow, PageUp/PageDown and Home/End values, RTL from a dir ancestor including one set after mount, vertical aria-orientation, and format-driven aria-valuetext). The new Vertical and Formatted stories and the extended slider.apg.spec.ts (exact PageUp/PageDown, exact RTL mirror, vertical, valuetext) still need the remote L5 browser lane.

The jest half was already green. I added a DragProbe story and a 'Slider drag' case in controls-perf.spec.ts (at most 1 forwarded onValueChange per rAF during a 120-move drag, 0 long tasks), fixed the PRD citation and the stale Slider.css header. The perf case only runs on the remote L10 lane.

Removed the vacuous '|| focusedChip === input' escape, added a jest case for Home/End moving the caret, and added src/components/combobox to the cmp:test:foundation-pattern jest dirs. I added a MultiKeyboard story and extended combobox.apg.spec.ts (Escape twice clears, Alt+ArrowDown, Home/End caret, multi-chip Backspace/Arrow/Delete); those need remote L5.

Jest is green: 10,000 items render at most 60 option nodes; typing 'Row 99' filters the rows and sets aria-setsize to 111; ArrowDown past the window and ArrowUp wrapping to row 10000 keep aria-activedescendant on a mounted node; a scroll re-windows on the next frame. I also added a Virtualized story and a 10,000-item controls-perf case, which need remote L10.

app-shell.css now hides only non-floating tab bars outside compact. The TabBar SurfaceGroup (the real grid child) carries the slot geometry, and a floating bar is a centred, bottom-anchored overlay on Main at every width that adds bottom scroll padding. I removed a rule that out-ranked the compact re-show of the bar. Jest structure tests are green; tabbar-minimize.spec 'bar only in compact' needs remote L9.

Added forced-colors rules: system colours on shell chrome; current-item cue (Highlight plus outline and/or underline) for Sidebar, TabBar, Tabs, Breadcrumbs and Pagination; focus is outline 2px solid Highlight; CMP Slider and media scrubber use CanvasText/Highlight; legend and tooltip swatches keep their fill and get a CanvasText border; AI caret and dots use CanvasText. Added [data-ag-contrast=more] and prefers-contrast rules for TopBar and Sidebar edges, ink and the current-item indicator. A static jest test is green. I rewrote forced-colors.spec.ts (0 visible backdrop filters across every SURF story, plus cue, focus, slider and swatch checks) and preferences.spec.ts (TopBar/Sidebar pixel diff >0.5%, axe colour-contrast under contrast more, tinted/solid rungs incl. CDP prefers-reduced-transparency). Both need the remote browser lane.

Not attempted: this needs a remote qual:certify:l6 run over 8 scenes × light/dark × 3 rungs × 2 widths × 3 engines to find the failing text runs first. Fixing blind from here is not possible because it needs browsers and rendered pixels.

Implemented and covered by jsdom tests. Overflow now measures the bar's content width against its parent with one ResizeObserver: low-priority items unmount into a trailing Menu whose trigger is a Toolbar.Button. The old self-referencing inline-size container (it collapsed an inline-flex bar to padding width) and the fixed 480px query are gone. Also: Base UI's Toolbar never enabled Home/End, so the root handles them; disabled items are now skipped by default (Base UI defaults focusableWhenDisabled to true); and `loop` is actually forwarded as loopFocus (it used to be dropped). The rewritten toolbar.apg.spec.ts (Keyboard + new Overflow story) and the concentric-radius check in controls-nesting.spec.ts need the browser lanes L5/L6.

Implemented and covered by unit tests. While it moves, the indicator gets data-ag-animating + data-ag-allow-nested through a new MAT helper, setMovingOptics. A new material.css rule at (0,1,1) specificity, placed after the group rule, restores its own backdrop while it moves; every later rung reset still wins. The move uses a View Transition via startMorph when the engine has one, otherwise a CSS transition (skipped while [data-ag-vt] is set). Calm/none and reduced motion jump. The checked-item platter is removed. Default story now has 3 items with the first selected. controls-motion.spec.ts is registered in L9. The APG spec forces the CSS path and asserts glass while moving and none at rest; it needs L5.

TextField, SearchField and NumberField roots now have inline-size:100% and min-inline-size:0. tests/e2e/cmp/sizing.spec.ts gained a section 4.4 check (sm/md/lg = 28/36/44px, ±0.5px) on the Button Density, IconButton Sizes and Select Density stories, and is registered in L6. This is browser-only.

Tabs, SegmentedControl and SourceTransition now take names from useMorphName (sanitised to [a-z0-9-]) and render data-ag-vt-participant. Tabs and SegmentedControl are also wrapped in <ViewTransition share='ag-morph'> when React ships it (19.3 does), through withMorph in control-shared/morph.tsx. SourceTransition names are now <useMorphName scope>-<id>, and element lookup is scoped to its Root. It is not wrapped in ViewTransition because its source and destination are mounted at the same time with the same name. Not done: TabBar has no morph indicator to wire, and no Menu-to-Sheet presentation exists in the code (MOT-101 moved to CMP). Building that presentation is too large for this pass. mat:test:motion-l9 needs a browser.

The bar is now exactly 48px at a fine pointer and 56px at a coarse one (block-size from space-12, and space-12 + space-2), border-box, padding space-1, with artwork 40/44px. The progress hairline is drawn absolutely over the bottom edge, so it adds no grid row. Fixed bars add env(safe-area-inset-bottom). Covered by a CSS unit test. now-playing-container.spec.ts gained height assertions, including a coarse-pointer describe. Its one-row band check now excludes the progress hairline, which gets its own bottom-edge assertion. The 320px expectation now lists progress as visible: the container query never hid it, so the old expectation looked wrong. Needs L1/L5 in a browser.

Tone rules are keyed on [data-ag-backdrop=media][data-ag-media-tone=light|dark] and declare only `color` on SURF small chrome. MAT floors are untouched. Analysis: every small-chrome glyph sits on a fill at MAT's media tint floor of at least 0.78 canvas, so the higher-contrast polarity for both tones is the scheme on-surface ink. The rule therefore pins that ink and never flips toward the media's own polarity. A CSS unit test checks this. An L6 block in text-contrast.spec.ts runs every scene and scheme with the tone forced light, dark and off, and asserts worst(on) >= worst(off); it needs the remote L6 lane. It is already covered by the surf.ts clear-over-media glob.

Two new jsdom/CSS tests are green: required + Field.Error on submit, and the --anchor-width / min(60dvh, 400px) assertions. The 390px popup e2e (tests/e2e/cmp/controls/select-390.spec.ts, registered on L6 in fragments/lanes/cmp.ts) needs a browser in CI.

Implemented: the controls.css ring is folded into src/a11y/css/focus.css (ag.a11y layer, keyed on [data-ag-focusable], .ag-focusable, every focusable [data-ag-part] and text shells' :focus-within). All component :focus-visible rings and rest-state outline:none are removed from src. data-ag-focus-inset is added to clipped parts. A new L1 pr/main failClosed verifier (scripts/mat/verify-focus-single-owner.mjs, with tests) reports 0 findings, and verify-a11y-removals reuses it. focus-appearance.spec.ts now measures rendered pixels (3:1 changed-pixel contrast over at least a 2px perimeter) across all 8 scenes. That browser spec needs CI.

Hit areas added to Tabs, TabBar, Pagination (link, button and manual parts), Toast action/close and the MediaControls toolbar buttons (no longer suppressed). IconButton already had one through Button. Metas updated and a jsdom test added. The fine spec now checks a centred 24x24 box or the 24px spacing exception (the old check passed any size), and the coarse spec checks ±21.5px elementFromPoint ownership, using the shared helper tests/e2e/mat/helpers/targets.ts. Rendered sizes need a browser in CI.

BackdropTone keeps a stable gate (the intersection state survives re-renders). The pause control has the fixed name 'Pause background video' and aria-pressed; when nothing plays or the user has not paused it is `hidden` (not focusable). It stays in the DOM because the meta parts conformance test requires every listed part to render in some story. jsdom tests with a fake IntersectionObserver are green. tests/e2e/surf/backdrops/motion.spec.ts was rewritten (paused with poster after 2s, offscreen pause within 250ms, hidden-tab pause, reduced motion, toggle) using new VideoContinuous stories that play /scenes/video-frame.webm. Needs a browser in CI.

BackdropDriftLayer and the media layer call MAT observeOffscreen on the root and set data-backdrop-hidden while the tab is hidden. The CSS uses animation longhands so the pause rule actually wins (the shorthand reset play-state). The L10 decision (transform: translate3d, never background-position) is recorded in backdrops.css. jsdom and CSS tests are green. tests/e2e/surf/motion/backdrop-drift.spec.ts was created (L9 row already existed). Needs a browser in CI.

preset='grain' now sets data-backdrop-grain (SSR test). modes.spec.ts was rewritten: forced colours (layer display:none, root background is Canvas), the solid transparency rung keeps media visible, and the grain tile renders. Real build bug fixed: fragment url()s shipped as '../assets/…' relative to dist/backdrops.css, which resolves outside the package. scripts/build/lib/css.mjs now rebases them and copies the assets into dist, and verify-pack.js fails on any unresolved packed css url(). Unit and fixture tests are green; the real tarball and browser checks need CI.

MAT hit-area spans added to about 35 SURF native interactive parts: media, ai, data, breadcrumbs, sidebar items and tree chevrons, each with a zero-specificity position:relative containing block. Carousel dots space out under coarse pointers. 14 metas, docs and one snapshot regenerated. tests/e2e/surf/target-size.spec.ts now runs fine and coarse probes over every SURF story and is registered as project surf:targets plus L5 pr/main rows. Not yet seen in a browser: dense toolbars such as the ImageViewer zoom buttons may need data-ag-hit-clamp once CI measures overlap.

Switch.css now sizes the track from the --ag-switch-track-{w,h}-* tokens as a border-box with the 2px --_ag-switch-thumb-inset. The thumb is track-h - 2*inset and slides track-w - track-h. Jest checks the token references for all three sizes. The computed 32x18/40x22/52x30 box and 2px-inset check is a new Playwright spec, tests/visual/cmp/controls/switch-sizes.spec.ts, against the new Switch Sizes story (lane L6). It has not been run in a browser.

The thumb now carries allowNested (glass optics) together with data-ag-animating only while it moves, and returns to the inner fill at rest (jest-proved). The translate distance is fixed. switch-sizes.spec.ts (L6) asserts that the computed translate changes, that translate is in transition-property, and that the duration is 0 under calm. It has not been run in a browser.

Popover and Menu/ContextMenu now enter with opacity plus scale(0.96) from var(--transform-origin) through starting/ending-style. Menu moved from keyframes to transitions. Select and Combobox move their transition to the resting rule, so the enter animates as well as the exit. useOverlayAnimating handles keyframe animationstart/animationend and is attached to the Select, Combobox and Toast popups (jest-proved). tests/e2e/cmp/overlays/motion.spec.ts was rewritten to record the data-starting-style frame live and assert: matrix(0.96...) for popover and menu, a pure translate matrix for the Sheet, data-ag-animating present during the enter and gone after transitionend, and scrim transitionProperty === 'opacity'. It needs a browser run. Tooltip deliberately keeps the 2px translate enter because REQ-CMP-101 requires it, which conflicts with the generic REQ-CMP-83 wording.

The arrow now paints the popup's inherited --ag-surface-fill inside an --ag-surface-rim edge using ::before/::after triangles, with no backdrop-filter. A new ClickToOpen story is closed at load. popover.apg.spec.ts now covers click-open (focus moves into the popup, aria-controls equals the popup id, role=dialog), Escape returning focus to the trigger, outside press, and the arrow's computed fill/rim matching the popup read-outs. Browser-only (L5).

Every overlay root now routes Escape through the LayerStack. Dialog, AlertDialog and Sheet pass actionsRef to Base.Root. Popover, Menu, Submenu, ContextMenu and Tooltip use a root-side useRoutedRootActions that their popup registration uses, and report reason 'escape-key'. Select and Combobox have no BU imperative close, so they now drive BU open (controlled) and close through the stack. tests/overlays/cmp/escape-routing.test.tsx proves all 9 roots plus a Dialog>Popover stack (one Escape per layer). Its two routing cases fail against the pre-change Popover. Outside press stays BU-owned and this is documented in useOverlayLayer. tests/e2e/cmp/overlays/overlay-stack.spec.ts is now registered as an L5 row; it needs a browser run.

Sheet has a new layerKind?: 'sheet'|'drawer' prop. Sidebar.Drawer passes layerKind='drawer' and the logical side, so it no longer resolves a physical side itself. Jest proves the stack entry is {kind:'drawer', modal:true}, and that a scrim click closes the drawer and returns focus to the toggle. A scrim-click case was added to tests/e2e/surf/app-shell/sidebar-drawer.spec.ts and needs a browser run.

Done on the next line, and the gap's items 1-3 have tests. classify-change.mjs now parses fragments at base and HEAD with loadFragments: 577 entries, breaking 'Bnn', any key order. A test runs this over the committed fragments. Export snapshots are real by default, and tag pipelines get --require-snapshots. New main()-level temp-repo tests cover root export added -> C-E and fragment entry added -> C-D. Item 4, porting to release/4.x and release/4.1.x (where the 4.1.x classify-change.test.ts is 0 bytes), needs a branch cut from those lines. This worktree is based on next.

Tests cover every PRD case through main() on a temp repo. Still open: rewriting the release/4.x visual-fixes records to this schema, removing 4.1.1-font-fallback.md (needs a 4.x branch), and the OD-14 CODEOWNERS reviewer for docs/release/** (owner decision).

Done on the next line. Each ref's fragments are loaded at that ref. Removals resolve their breaking group through the merged base+HEAD set by exact symbol. Temp-repo main() tests cover three cases: two groups -> exit 1; Multi-Family on the head commit -> 0; trailer only on a non-head commit -> 1. The port to release/4.x and 4.1.x (whose test is 0 bytes) needs a 4.x-based branch.

export-snapshot.mjs now has: jsdom globals in the runner, TypeScript compiler API types (getExportsOfModule, so export * and export {} from are followed, plus a typeValues subset), --version via npm pack, an --install mode that installs peers, a Node >= 20.19 guard, an asset `file` field, and a boolean typesRuntimeMismatch with names in mismatch[]. It then runs verify-breaking-register --coverage-only with both snapshots, writing deprecation-coverage.json to the job dir. This is non-blocking on PR, main and pre-release, and blocking with --require-covered on the v5.0.0 tag. classify-change's deprecationCoverage now uses lib/deprecation-coverage's entryJudge, with exact symbols (the substring match is gone) and the allowlist. It has to run in GitLab to show the report.

All remaining work is on release/4.x: etc/api/*.exports.json at the 4.2 cut showing typesRuntimeMismatch:false for /forms and /data, and a report-mode loop of scripts/ci/import-side-effects.mjs over dist/*.mjs in the 4.x plat:build:dist. That script exists only on release/4.x and is not on next. It needs a 4.x-based branch. The new export-snapshot boolean typesRuntimeMismatch is what that evidence should use.

Run `node scripts/release/sync-fragments.mjs --to next` and `--to release/4.x` from a clean PLAT worktree with the existing gh login, merge both sync PRs, then confirm that diff -r of fragments/deprecations is empty. motion.css now sets will-change only under [data-ag-animating], and the jest proof is in. Still open: layer-stack.spec.ts and tiers.spec.ts must pass on 3 engines, then mat:test:material-browsers can be flipped from allow_failure through its activation row. This needs the remote browser lane.
